policy: Do not infer historical report URLs. Each unresolved year must be backed by an official OSPI resource or a documented archival source before it can be used for reconciliation.

control_strategy.district_annual: Use year-specific final Personnel Summary Reports when an official OSPI annual resource is available.
control_strategy.longitudinal_statewide: Use longitudinal tables embedded in current/final OSPI Personnel Summary Reports for historical trend controls when the table definition matches the project measure.
control_strategy.rule: A longitudinal table is a separate control source and does not resolve an unavailable historical annual district report.
